thread:
alex: Heads-up — RC2 cutoff in ~45m. There's a late change that bumps the version and updates the changelog. asking if we can lift freeze for a targeted merge. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/5123

natalie: what's the risk? is it docs-only or code-path?

alex: it's a small runtime tweak + changelog entry. touches metrics export. PR diff small, tests pass locally. CI is currently running.

mike: @alex can you paste the commit hash and a short revert plan if this regresses?

alex: commit `abc1234` — plan: if it breaks we'll revert the cherry-pick and rollback the canary. should take ~10m.

jin: CI status? @ci-bot any flakes?

ci-bot: build #7842: running -> unit tests green, integration tests queued. no known flakes on this branch.

sophia: changelog owners, pinged. realize changelog lives in `docs/changelog/rc-2.md` — do we have an owner for the entry?

natalie: I can add the changelog blurb now. will push a small edit once merged or during the lift.

alex: proposed cherry-pick command if approved:
```
git fetch origin main
git checkout -b lift-rc2-abc1234
git cherry-pick -x abc1234
# run unit tests, smoke locally
```

mike: my call — I'm okay with a single targeted lift if QA gives quick smoke + CI turns green. but want explicit rollback steps and a post-merge watch (30m).

alex: ack. rolling plan: merge -> ci -> canary deploy to staging -> 15m smoke -> promote. rollback: revert cherry-pick + `kubectl rollout undo` for inference runtime.

sophia: @release-bot can you open a rollback incident template and assign to oncall if needed?

release-bot: rollback-template created: https://internal/redwood/incidents/ROLLBACK-2026-09-07-1 assigned to #oncall.

jin: integration tests just passed. green.

mike: okay good — @alex go ahead on the merge. ensure changelog commit follows same PR or immediate follow-up.

alex: merging in 30s. will ping here when done.

ci-bot: merge queued for PR #5123 -> merging now.

alex: merged. CI shows all pipelines green. starting canary deploy to staging.

sophia: adding changelog entry now: small note about metrics flag. PR #5125.

mike: watching metrics and error rates. will call rollback on any >2x error or 20% latency spike within 30m.

natalie: changelog PR merged. :memo:

jin: staging canary healthy at +10m, no errors.

alex: promoting to rc channel in 5m.

release-bot: promotion job started -> rc-2/stage -> rc-2/prod (manual approval pending).

mike: approved production promote.

alex: promoted. production canary is steady at +12m. no regressions observed. great job. :tada:

sophia: noted for release notes. thanks everyone for quick triage.

mike: closing this thread — if anything crops up, reopen with incident link. :thumbsup:
